cell_type_or_model: spinal neurons and demyelinating CNS tissue
assay_or_perturbation: WNT5A/ROR2 perturbation; JNK activation; neuronal survival/death assays
evidence_summary: WNT5A-ROR2 signaling was linked to JNK activation and spinal-neuron death in a demyelinating CNS context.
limitations: The evidence does not resolve FZD3 as the exclusive WNT5A receptor or a terminal TCF/LEF target.

cell_type_or_model: spinal neural stem cells after SCI
assay_or_perturbation: WNT5A treatment; JNK/MAPK inhibition; neural-stem-cell differentiation assays
evidence_summary: WNT5A-MAPK/JNK signaling was associated with neuronal differentiation of spinal neural stem cells after SCI.
limitations: The terminal transcription factor was not resolved; this is not canonical β-catenin/TCF-LEF evidence.

assay_or_perturbation: WNT5A/FZD5/LRP5 context; active β-catenin and TCF/LEF reporter; proliferation/self-renewal assays
evidence_summary: WNT5A-FZD5/LRP5-associated β-catenin/TCF-LEF activity was linked to eMSC proliferation and self-renewal.
limitations: Direct WNT5A-LRP5 contact and a unique receptor-proximal relay were not isolated; retain boundary status for the 20B LR row.

assay_or_perturbation: FZD10 perturbation/overexpression; WNT1/WNT3A signaling and dorsal spinal-cord patterning assays
evidence_summary: The FZD10 study provides developmental WNT receptor-context evidence but does not supply a matched WNT5A-FZD10 terminal relay for the current handoff.
limitations: WNT1/WNT3A rather than WNT5A was the primary developmental ligand context; it is retained only to document the search boundary and prevent ligand substitution.
